maddeler.e:
نعتذر (form VIII)
# نَعْتَذِرُ (naʕtaḏiru) /naʕ.ta.ði.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# نُعْتَذَرُ (nuʕtaḏaru) /nuʕ.ta.ða.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# نَعْتَذِرَ (naʕtaḏira) /naʕ.ta.ði.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# نُعْتَذَرَ (nuʕtaḏara) /nuʕ.ta.ða.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
